<div class="card-body">
'''You Will Go To The Dagobah System''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">おまえはダゴバ星系に行くのだ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに２フォース消費して[Hoth]がついた自分の任意の能力値＞1のキャラクターを1人、自分の人員がいる[Dagobah]がついたロケーションに移動させる。ダゴバの位置に移動させるなら、移動にはフォースを消費せず、そこに人員がいる必要もない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-You-Will-Go-To-The-Dagobah-System-PSA-93899917.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「そこでお前はヨーダから学ぶ。私の師たるジェダイ・マスターだ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' You Will Go To The Dagobah System.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, use 2 Force to move one of your [Hoth] characters of ability greater than 1 to a [Dagobah] location where you have presence. If moving to a Dagobah location, the move costs no Force and does not need presence.

'''Lore:'''
There you will learn from Yoda. He is the Jedi Master who taught me.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Paid move costs 2 Force; English costs 1 Force.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
